title: Igor Schwarzmann — Writing
subtitle: Essays, concepts, and notes by Igor Schwarzmann on culture, technology, and AI.

posts.title: Designing Systems Where Trust Is the Output
posts.description: A rice cooker that plays a tune, the Japanese idea of anshin, and what it takes to design agents so that trust becomes their output.

posts.title: Holding Your Organization's Attention
posts.description: Insights, innovation and foresight teams matter when they hold the attention of the people who decide. AI makes delivery shaped for each audience affordable.

posts.title: Building a knowledge-work harness: notes from GOSIM Shenzhen
posts.description: A field report given at the GOSIM Shenzhen Agentic AI Summit: what happens when you take the coding harness idea into a job without a compiler, and why the gains stay with individuals until an organization writes down how it works.
